name: pdf-designer-design-hub
description: OPTIONAL page x breakpoint manifest for screenshotting the Design Hub UI with an external breakpoint-capture tool. pdf-designer never needs it: documents are captured by the built-in python -m pdf_tool.pdf_to_png. Public-safe (examples-profile routes only). Start the Hub first: python -m pdf_tool.preview --no-open --port 8787.

notes.splash: ?no-splash skips the launch title; the Hub also skips it for the rest of a session once dismissed.
notes.output: Captures are ephemeral QA evidence: write to a scratch/temp directory and delete after review. Never commit PNGs; _exports/ is the user-facing document library, not a screenshot dump.
notes.matrix: breakpointProfile names a shared sampling matrix in the capture tool; tools without that profile can use the Hub's own tiers (390, 576, 768, 992, 1200, 1400, 1920) from src/pdf_tool/static/hub.css.
notes.interaction: Drawer open/resize, custom selects, and hover states need a real pointer — use a human-sim / pointer-driven QA tool, not a static sweep.
